fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 28% match is a WEAK FIT for this Program Manager role, so upskilling comes first.

**Strengths:**
- Curriculum design: wrote Year 9 practical curriculum, trained 12 colleagues
- Workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching across varied audiences
- Spreadsheet progress tracking, reported to senior leadership each term

**Gaps:**
- No 4+ years in B2B SaaS or customer onboarding
- No technical product implementation or large-scale customer webinar experience
- No project management, marketing collaboration or customer feedback analysis

**Recommendation:** Build SaaS exposure first through a customer success or onboarding specialist role, then reapply once you can show onboarding metrics.

Dear Hiring Manager,

Getting a high volume of people to understand something technical, and to keep using it, is the problem your Scale Onboarding role exists to solve. I've spent 8 years in the classroom doing a version of it, and I wrote the Year 9 practical curriculum for my department and trained 12 colleagues to use it.

That's the same loop your ad describes: build the materials, teach them, then see what the results say. I teach about 140 students a year across Years 9 to 13, so I'm used to many people at different levels of confidence at once. I track progress in spreadsheets (Excel pivot tables and lookups, plus basic Python with pandas) and present results to senior leadership each term, which is how I'd approach metrics and customer feedback reporting. Weekly parent calls have also taught me to speak with people of very different backgrounds. I haven't worked in B2B SaaS, and I'm not claiming to have. I am a quick learner who builds enablement resources, and I'm working through the Google Data Analytics Certificate now.

Your "Grow as you go" value describes how I work. I'd welcome a conversation about how I could help shape scale onboarding for your commercial customers in London, and I'm available to talk at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I've spent 8 years explaining difficult ideas to groups of learners, and I wrote a practical curriculum for my department and trained 12 colleagues to use it, which is the kind of program building and enablement your onboarding role needs. I also track progress in spreadsheets and report results to senior leadership each term, so I'm comfortable with metrics and clear communication at different levels. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a call at any time that suits you, with a short notice period for a start.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
